QuestInfo.name: The Lost Black Key
QuestInfo.0: You lost the #t4032471#! What should you do? #b#p1013202##k starts talking to you... How did he know?
QuestInfo.1: #p1013202# says that he will let it pass just this once, then tells you to bring more #b#t4000593#s#k to #p2022003#. If you do that, he will give you the item again...\n\nYou can enter the Forest of the Dead from the open door located at the right side of the bottom floor of the Chief's Residence.

0.0: Oh no, it seems you've lost the item. This affects the entire organization! Alright, I'll let this one go, but you're going to have to collect another #t4000069# right away.
0.1: Well, it's just like last time... No, actually, that's not going to be enough. This time, you're going to have to collect #b300 #t4000069#s#k and deliver them to #b#p2022003##k. Only then will #p2022003# give you the item again.

yes.0: You can enter the Forest of the Dead through the rightmost door on the bottom floor of Chief's Residence.

no.0: Honestly, one mistake is enough. If you are making yet another mistake by refusing to take on this assignment, then I just don't know if you'll be excused again.

1.0: Hehe. So you want me to give you the item again? Alright. I've made like 10 copies of the key anyway. Kekeke!

npc.0: Don't tell me you haven't brought #b300 #t4000593#s#k to #b#p2022003##k yet! Hurry! It's very important!

item.0: What is it? You want me to give you another one of the items? Hehehe. Well, if you want another one of those, you're going to have to bring me 150... No, no, #b300#k #b#t4000593#s#k!
